description: This Java class `ClusterCommandEvent` defines an event representing a cluster command received in a Zigbee-like protocol simulation. It includes properties for device identifiers, command details, and signal quality metrics, along with multiple constructors and accessor methods. The class extends `Event` and utilizes Base64 encoding for command payloads.

classes.name: ClusterCommandEvent
classes.description: Represents a Zigbee cluster command received event with properties such as EUI64, profile, endpoint, cluster, command ID, and signal metrics. Provides methods to access these properties and generate Base64-encoded payloads.
